The '''S9-series heavy power droid''' was a 0.75-meter tall model from [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. It had a reinforced chassis, [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], a [[Binary/Legends|binary]] [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], an internal [[heavy generator]], heavy treaded wheels, and a six-meter extendable power transfer cable. In overall appearance, it somewhat resembled a bulkier version of a [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droid]]. It was sold as an advanced replacement to the [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]], which did not sell well. While the EG-6 could easily recharge a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], the S9 could recharge a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The model could handle rough terrain, making it popular with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cells such as on [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]], where several of the droids were modified to harass [[Radiation zone assault trooper|radtroopers]].
